_readme: Runtime overrides for the Recommendations section. Any non-empty string field here replaces the bundled default for the same id; delete a field (or this whole file) and the default comes back. Add a new object with id, name, text and profileUrl to show another recommendation. Update verifiedOn (YYYY-MM-DD) whenever you re-check a profile.
